The rep recovers with an honest admission of confusion and lands a next-day phone appointment, but the booking is fragile — device-access and terminology concerns are left open.

primary_coaching_focus.topic: non-standard scenario recognition (off-grid / battery-only / manufactured home)
primary_coaching_focus.quote: the only thing that I will need from you is just a copy of your kilowatt usage.
primary_coaching_focus.why: Two separate mid-call holds were needed because the rep tried to run a standard solar-bill-collection script on a customer who had already disclosed she has zero utility service. The information was on the table well before the rep asked for the bill — this is a listening/pattern-recognition gap the manager can close with a quick scenario checklist.

key_moments.quote: This might be the dumbest question ever, but my friend's not working. Can we still have a battery to a manufactured home?
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep has no internal knowledge of whether a battery-only install works on a manufactured home and must stop the call to check. This is a routing/training gap, not a customer-facing failure, since the customer wasn't kept waiting long and wasn't told the reason.

key_moments.quote: Yeah. He it would be orphaned because he has solar.
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep refers to Kelly, a female customer who introduced herself by name minutes earlier, as 'he' while relaying the supervisor's answer — following the 'my friend' reference at 06:59. This is an internal-facing slip (not heard by the customer) but signals the rep isn't tracking the customer as a specific named person mid-call.

key_moments.quote: Why do I need a credit score? I I'm not I'm not financing.
key_moments.stewart_read: The rep asked the standard financing-credit qualifier without first asking about payment method, even though the customer had already signaled independence/self-sufficiency (off-grid, building her own home). This is the reactive read: rep ran the script beat mechanically instead of listening for cash-buyer signals already on the table.
